subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: Few months ago, I saw a gentleman (a) ----- was from Australia. He came to our university (b) ----- he was sent for an assignment from his country. (c) ----- I first met him, I came to know (d) ----- he was a Professor of University of oslo. His work was to study the teaching method of ours. He sometimes discussed with me the teaching methodology (e) ----- was applied in his university.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) who; (b) as; (c) When; (d) that; (e) that.
